Game Overview

At its heart, Toca Avatar: My House is a girls' game about design your dream house in Toca Avatar: My House. Unleash your creativity by rearranging furniture, organizing spaces, and perfecting every detail. Experience the joy of personalizing your vibrant virtual sanctuary, from kitty care to kitchen mastery, everything is at your fingertips. Dive into a world of endless home adventures!
